testimonials_single_video_source.name: testimonials_single_video_source
testimonials_single_video_source.value: NOT ("testimonials"."video_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND length("testimonials"."video_url") > 0)

assessments_children_consistency.name: assessments_children_consistency
assessments_children_consistency.value:
("assessments"."has_children" = 1 AND "assessments"."number_of_children" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("assessments"."has_children" = 0 AND "assessments"."number_of_children" IS NULL)

assessments_passport_consistency.name: assessments_passport_consistency
assessments_passport_consistency.value:
("assessments"."has_passport" = 1 AND "assessments"."passport_number" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("assessments"."has_passport" = 0 AND "assessments"."passport_number" IS NULL)
